name: llm_tool_agent_failures
title: Tool or agent failed 5+ times in 15 minutes
description: A tool call or agent run failed 5 or more times in the last 15 minutes (execute_tool, invoke_agent or invoke_workflow spans with status ERROR). Tools that report not-found as an error can trigger it. Needs LLM spans in the traces stream named default; OpenObserve writes the gen_ai columns at ingest.

query_condition.sql: SELECT gen_ai_operation_name, gen_ai_tool_name, gen_ai_agent_name, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM "default" WHERE span_status = 'ERROR' AND gen_ai_operation_name IN ('execute_tool', 'invoke_agent', 'invoke_workflow') GROUP BY gen_ai_operation_name, gen_ai_tool_name, gen_ai_agent_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
